findings.source: Sirin: Если она всё же сорвётся искать его, мне придётся пойти тоже.
findings.currentTarget: Sirin: Akiamua tena kwenda kumtafuta, itabidi nami niende.
findings.proposedFullTarget: Sirin: Akiamua kwenda kumtafuta hata hivyo, itabidi nami niende.
findings.objectiveReason: всё же means nonetheless, not again. In this stage Alkonost is considering going out to search; tena incorrectly states a repeated decision/search before the subsequent discovery.

The antecedent is the retained photograph, translated picha in the immediately preceding unit. Its noun class requires i-, not li-; Russian feminine agreement does not make the Swahili picture class 5.

findings.source: Scammer: Да и тем более, сейчас мне на них кристально похуй.
findings.currentTarget: Scammer: Zaidi ya hayo, sasa sijali chochote kuhusu wao.
findings.proposedFullTarget: Scammer: Zaidi ya hayo, sasa sijali chochote kuhusu hayo.
findings.objectiveReason: The immediately preceding named antecedent is debts, madeni. wao refers to animate people, switching the referent; hayo preserves the debts without inventing persons.
